text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Taking the previous results into account, I have conducted countless studies and experiments up until today, but..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder how things will turn out.
I'd rather not repeat the same mistake.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"There are no absolutes, but wishing for one
is only natural for a seeker of possibilities, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, very well! Expect nothing less
than the finest results, Trainer-kun!
